dishes.name: Bajra Roti
recipeSteps: Mix bajra flour with warm water and knead into soft dough
Divide into balls, flatten by hand on a rolling board
Cook on hot tawa, flipping until golden spots appear
Apply ghee and serve hot

dishes.name: Jowar Roti
recipeSteps: Mix jowar flour with warm water, knead soft dough
Pat into flat rounds using hands or rolling pin
Cook on tawa both sides, puff on direct flame
Serve with ghee

dishes.name: Ragi Roti
recipeSteps: Mix ragi flour with warm water and salt, knead
Roll into thin rotis on dusted surface
Cook on hot tawa, flip, cook both sides
Apply ghee

dishes.name: Wheat Roti (Phulka)
recipeSteps: Knead wheat flour with water into soft dough, rest 10 min
Divide into balls, roll into thin circles
Cook on tawa, flip, puff on open flame
Apply ghee, serve

dishes.name: Jeera Rice
recipeSteps: Cook basmati rice until 80% done, drain
Heat ghee, add cumin seeds till they crackle
Add cooked rice, salt, mix gently
Steam covered 5 min, fluff with fork

dishes.name: Steamed Basmati Rice
recipeSteps: Wash rice 2-3 times, soak 20 min
Boil water (2x rice volume), add rice and salt
Cook until water absorbed, fluff with fork
Rest covered 5 min

dishes.name: Peas Pulao
recipeSteps: Sauté cumin, bay leaf, cinnamon in ghee
Add soaked rice, peas, salt, water (2x)
Cook covered on low flame until done
Fluff and garnish with coriander

dishes.name: Paneer Bhurji
recipeSteps: Sauté cumin, onion, ginger, green chili in oil
Add tomatoes, turmeric, chili powder, cook till soft
Crumble paneer, add and stir fry 5 min
Finish with garam masala and coriander

dishes.name: Palak Paneer
recipeSteps: Blanch spinach, blend into smooth puree
Sauté cumin, onion, ginger-garlic in butter
Add spinach puree, salt, garam masala, simmer
Add paneer cubes, cook 5 min, finish with cream

dishes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
recipeSteps: Sauté onion, ginger, garlic, tomato — blend into smooth gravy
Melt butter, add gravy, red chili powder, kasuri methi, cream
Add paneer cubes, simmer 10 min
Finish with cream swirl and coriander

dishes.name: Kadai Paneer
recipeSteps: Dry roast coriander seeds and red chili, grind coarse (kadai masala)
Sauté onion, capsicum, tomato in oil till crunchy
Add kadai masala, ginger, paneer cubes
Toss well, finish with cream and coriander

dishes.name: Baingan Bharta
recipeSteps: Roast whole eggplant on open flame until charred, peel skin
Mash the flesh
Sauté cumin, onion, ginger, green chili, tomato in oil
Add mashed eggplant, turmeric, salt, cook 10 min
Finish with coriander

dishes.name: Chana Masala
recipeSteps: Soak chana overnight, boil with salt till soft
Sauté cumin, onion, ginger-garlic till golden
Add tomato puree, chana masala spices, cook till oil separates
Add boiled chana, simmer 15 min, garnish with onion and lemon

dishes.name: Rajma Masala
recipeSteps: Soak rajma overnight, pressure cook with salt
Sauté cumin, onion, ginger-garlic till brown
Add tomato puree, turmeric, chili, coriander powders
Add boiled rajma, simmer 20 min, finish with garam masala

dishes.name: Chicken Curry
recipeSteps: Marinate chicken with turmeric, chili, salt 15 min
Sauté onion, ginger-garlic till brown
Add tomato, spices, cook till oil separates
Add chicken, cook 20 min covered, finish with coriander

dishes.name: Butter Chicken
recipeSteps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, chili, turmeric, garam masala
Grill/tandoor until charred
Simmer tomato-butter-cream gravy with fenugreek
Add tikka pieces, simmer 10 min, finish with cream

dishes.name: Mutton Curry
recipeSteps: Marinate mutton with curd, turmeric, chili powder
Sauté whole spices, onion, ginger-garlic till dark brown
Add tomato, powdered spices, cook till oil separates
Add mutton, cook covered on low flame 45 min till tender

dishes.name: Dal Tadka
recipeSteps: Boil toor dal with turmeric, salt till soft, mash lightly
Heat ghee, add cumin, mustard, dry red chili, hing, garlic
Pour tadka over dal, add coriander, simmer 2 min

dishes.name: Dal Makhani
recipeSteps: Soak urad dal + rajma overnight, pressure cook
Sauté onion, ginger-garlic, tomato puree in butter
Add dal, cream, simmer on low 30-40 min
Finish with butter, cream, kasuri methi

dishes.name: Moong Dal (Yellow)
recipeSteps: Dry roast moong dal 2 min, boil with turmeric, salt till soft
Tadka: ghee, cumin, hing, garlic, green chili
Pour over dal, add lemon juice, coriander

dishes.name: Boondi Raita
recipeSteps: Whisk curd till smooth, add water if needed
Soak boondi in warm water 2 min, squeeze
Add boondi, salt, roasted cumin, chili powder to curd
Mix well, chill

dishes.name: Green Salad
recipeSteps: Slice cucumber, onion, tomato thinly
Arrange on plate, sprinkle salt, chaat masala
Squeeze lemon on top

dishes.name: Plain Curd
recipeSteps: Whisk curd until smooth
Serve chilled in a bowl

dishes.name: Cucumber Raita
recipeSteps: Grate cucumber, squeeze excess water
Whisk curd, add cucumber, salt, roasted cumin powder
Mix, garnish with coriander

dishes.name: Papad (Roasted)
recipeSteps: Roast papad on open flame or microwave 30 sec
Serve immediately

dishes.name: Pickle (Achar)
recipeSteps: Spoon pickle into a small bowl
Serve as accompaniment

dishes.name: Masala Omelette
recipeSteps: Beat eggs with chopped onion, tomato, green chili, coriander, salt
Heat oil in pan, pour mixture
Cook both sides till golden
Serve with bread or roti

dishes.name: Boiled Eggs
recipeSteps: Place eggs in cold water, bring to boil
Boil 8 min for hard, 6 min for soft
Peel, sprinkle salt and pepper, serve

dishes.name: Besan Chilla
recipeSteps: Mix besan with water to smooth batter, add salt, turmeric, chili
Add finely chopped onion, tomato, coriander
Pour on hot tawa like pancake, cook both sides
Serve with chutney or curd

dishes.name: Idli + Sambar
recipeSteps: Steam fermented idli batter in idli moulds 10-12 min
Sambar: boil toor dal, add tamarind water, sambar powder, vegetables
Temper with mustard, curry leaves, hing
Serve idlis hot with sambar and coconut chutney

dishes.name: Dosa (Plain/Masala)
recipeSteps: Spread fermented dosa batter thin on hot tawa
Drizzle oil, cook till crispy golden
For masala: fill with spiced potato filling
Serve with sambar and coconut chutney

dishes.name: Kanda Poha
recipeSteps: Wash poha, drain, keep aside
Sauté mustard, cumin, curry leaves, onion, green chili, peanuts in oil
Add turmeric, poha, salt, sugar, mix gently
Cover 2 min, garnish with coriander, lemon

dishes.name: Vegetable Upma
recipeSteps: Dry roast sooji till light golden, keep aside
Sauté mustard, urad dal, chana dal, curry leaves, onion, vegetables
Add water (3x sooji), salt, bring to boil
Add sooji slowly while stirring, cook till thick

dishes.name: Oats Porridge
recipeSteps: Cook oats with milk/water on low flame, stirring
Add salt or sugar based on preference
Top with fruits, nuts, or honey

dishes.name: Greek Yogurt Bowl
recipeSteps: Spoon thick curd into bowl
Top with fruits, nuts, seeds, honey
Serve immediately

dishes.name: Coconut Chutney
recipeSteps: Grind fresh grated coconut, green chili, ginger, roasted chana dal with water
Temper with mustard seeds, curry leaves, urad dal in oil
Pour tadka over chutney, mix in salt

dishes.name: Green Chutney (Mint-Coriander)
recipeSteps: Blend mint leaves, coriander leaves, green chili, ginger, lemon juice, salt with a splash of water
Adjust consistency — thick for spread, thin for dip
Serve fresh

dishes.name: Tomato Sauce (Ketchup)
recipeSteps: Pour tomato ketchup into a small bowl
Serve as dip with paratha, bread toast, or sandwiches

dishes.name: Peanut Chutney
recipeSteps: Dry roast peanuts, cool and remove skins
Grind with green chili, garlic, tamarind, salt, water
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves

dishes.name: Egg Bhurji
recipeSteps: Scramble eggs in bowl
Sauté onion, tomato, green chili in oil
Pour eggs, scramble continuously
Add salt, chili, finish with coriander
